hsr.name: Aeon ★ Aha
text: Star Rail's first playable Aeon. Aha, the Aeon of Elation, joins as a 5★ Quantum character on the Path of Elation, in the human form of Nihilux, the comic author from the Planarcadia story. A Star Lotto outfit draw comes with her.
hsr.question: A god of fun on a gacha banner: will Aha top the chart, or treat the whole thing as a joke? Pearl's #1 in Japan is the bar.

genshin.name: Mitya
text: A new 5★ Electro character, sharing the phase with a Furina rerun. Zibai and Linnea reruns follow on November 24, according to banner guides that cover the 7.2 livestream.
genshin.question: Genshin was 4th in Japan in October with ¥424M. Can a brand-new 5★ drag it back up, or is it the reruns doing the work again?

zzz.name: Severian
zzz.when: Version 3.3, second half · after Phoenix ends on November 11
text: Seth Lowell's long-awaited brother: an S-Rank Wind Attack agent from Public Security's Metropolitan Order Division, arriving with his W-Engine, Incarcerating Grip.
zzz.question: Phoenix won October's four-way opening week in both markets. Can the brother fans waited years for beat her, or does he land in her shadow?

wuwa.name: Version 3.8
wuwa.when: Not dated yet · Suoming runs until November 11
text: Kuro hasn't announced 3.8's date or its headliner. Third-party guides expect it around mid-November.
wuwa.question: Wuthering Waves doubled its month in October. Can it hold that with nobody confirmed to follow Suoming?

endfield.name: Next operator: not announced
text: We couldn't find an official announcement of the next operator yet.
endfield.question: Si gave Endfield one of its best China runs. Will the next operator keep China interested, or was Si the exception?

nte.name: Version 1.5
text: Reportedly two new S-Rank characters from the Bureau of Anomaly Control's ETD-6 division, one named Elyms. That comes from a livestream recap; Hotta hasn't confirmed it in anything we found.
nte.question: Akane Rin sits 9th of NTE's 10 banners in Japan so far. NTE needs a hit, not another middling launch.
